newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar closes around day's highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar closes around day's highs.

text.p: White sugar futures edged higher during late afternoon dealings on light shortcovering in a very thin market.
Near December last traded at $326.10, up $1 a tonne from Thursday, and total turnover was only 665 lots.
There was no news or developments in physicals to encourage fresh trading interest and most traders spent the afternoon watching the New York raws market, hoping for a lead.
December Paris closed at $325.50 a tonne, down $0.30.
